CREATE TABLE "public"."CreditInstallmentPlan" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hasImportedAmount" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "number" int2 NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CreditInstallmentPlan_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("purchaseId", "number")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CreditInstallmentRecord" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hasImportedAmount" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "number" int2 NOT NULL,
  "occurrenceDate" date NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "settledByPurchaseId" character varying(36),
  "statementId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CreditInstallmentRecord_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CreditPurchaseRecord" (
  "cashbackAccountId" character varying(36),
  "cashbackAmount" numeric(18,4),
  "cashbackYieldPeriod" "CashbackYieldPeriod",
  "cashbackYieldReferencePercentage" numeric(7,4),
  "cashbackYieldReferenceRate" numeric(7,4),
  "categoryId" character varying(36),
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditCardId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "externalId" character varying(200),
  "feeAmount" numeric(12,2),
  "feeDescription" character varying(100),
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "purchaseDate" date NOT NULL,
  "storeName" character varying(200),
  "subscriptionId" character varying(36),
  "subscriptionOccurrenceDate" date,
  "time" time(3),
  "totalAmount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CreditPurchaseRecord_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CreditRefundRecord" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "cancellationEligible" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditDate" date NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "policy" "CreditRefundPolicy" NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "statementId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CreditRefundRecord_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CreditStatementCharge" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "chargeDate" date NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying(500) NOT NULL,
  "id" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "statementId" character varying(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "CreditStatementCharge_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
